zh.headline: OpenAI 正式发布 GPT-5.6 系列（Luna/Terra/Sol）并获政府批准公开上线，同时推出“ChatGPT Work”自主 Agent。
zh.observation: 今天无疑是“模型发布大爆炸”的一天：OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 + ChatGPT Work、SpaceX 的 Grok 4.5、Meta 的 Muse Spark 1.1 在同一天集中上线，标志着 AI 竞争从“谁更强”全面转向“谁更便宜、谁更实用”。GPT-5.6 Sol 以 Fable 5 三分之一的价格实现接近的性能，Grok 4.5 和 Muse Spark 1.1 更是将定价压到新低——价格战已白热化。与此同时，多个开源项目（OfficeCLI、flint-chart、CubeSandbox）表明社区正在为 Agent 构建基础设施层，而非仅仅追逐模型本身。值得警惕的是，OpenAI 发现 SWE-Bench Pro 约 30% 任务有问题，提醒我们行业评测体系仍需完善。

items.title: OpenAI 正式发布 GPT-5.6 系列（Luna/Terra/Sol）并获政府批准公开上线，同时推出“ChatGPT Work”自主 Agent。
items.value: 三档定价覆盖不同需求，Sol 在 Agent 编码上超越所有竞品；ChatGPT Work 实现跨应用全流程自动化。

items.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-Live 全双工语音模型，ChatGPT 可同时听和说，对话更像真人。
items.value: 全双工架构彻底改善语音交互体验，复杂问题自动转交 GPT-5.5 处理，质量大幅提升。

items.title: SpaceX 发布 Grok 4.5，定价仅为竞品一半，专注编码与自主 Agent。
items.value: 1.5T 参数，$2/百万输入 tokens，性价比碾压，可能重塑 API 定价格局。

items.title: Meta 发布 Muse Spark 1.1 并开放 API，定价比 Grok 4.5 更低。
items.value: $4.25/百万输出 tokens，支持大规模 Agent 工作负载和代码迁移，加剧价格战。

items.title: OpenAI 关闭 ChatGPT Atlas 浏览器，将 Agent 浏览能力整合至桌面应用和 Chrome 扩展。
items.value: 战略收缩，聚焦 ChatGPT Work 产品线，而非独立浏览器。

items.title: Anthropic 将对 Claude Fable 5 收取基于使用量的额外费用，AI 订阅廉价时代或将终结。
items.value: Fable 5 推理成本过高，按量计费模式可能成为新常态。

items.title: OpenAI 首席未来学家离职，Anthropic 推出 Claude 使用回顾“Reflect”功能，Mistral 发布 8B 机器人导航模型。
items.value: 人才流动与产品迭代加速，开源机器人模型降低入门门槛。

items.title: Databricks 将中国开源模型 GLM 5.2 设为默认编码引擎，因其以更低成本匹配 Opus 性能。
items.value: $1.28/任务 vs $1.94，开源模型在特定场景已可替代闭源旗舰。

items.title: OpenAI 发现热门编程评测 SWE-Bench Pro 约 30% 任务存在问题，撤回此前背书。
items.value: 行业标杆评测可靠性受质疑，开发者应建立自有评测体系。

items.title: 《纽约时报》指控 OpenAI 在版权案中隐藏证据，伪造无法搜索训练数据的能力。
items.value: 法律战升级，可能影响 AI 训练数据合规实践。

items.title: Google 将披露哪些广告由 AI 制作，要求广告商标注 AI 生成/编辑内容。
items.value: AI 广告透明度新规，影响数字营销行业合规标准。

items.title: 69% 企业存在 AI Agent 共享 API 密钥的安全风险，单个 Agent 被攻陷可波及全部。
items.value: Agent 安全实践亟待规范，凭证管理成关键。

items.title: OpenAI 正探索多种广告形式，布局广告业务。
items.value: OpenAI 商业化加速，广告可能成为重要收入来源。

items.title: Agon：竞争性跨模型强化学习框架，让两个模型互为评分者，提升推理质量。
items.value: 解决 GRPO 只评分最终答案的局限，训练模型真正“思考更好”。

items.title: LingBot-Video：全球首个面向具身智能的 MoE 视频基模，蚂蚁灵波开源。
items.value: MoE 架构专为机器人设计，15 万小时数据训练，Zero-Shot 提升 31%。

items.title: LingBot-World 2.0：世界模型首次实现“小时级”持续生成，支持 60fps 720p 实时输出。
items.value: 因果预训练实现无限交互，实时变体驱动视频流，多人交互 AI 原生支持。

items.title: Sparse Delta Memory：通过稀疏性将线性 RNN 状态扩展到数百万，长上下文召回媲美 Transformer。
items.value: 突破线性注意力模型长上下文瓶颈，同时保持计算效率。

items.title: Is One Layer Enough? 单层 Transformer 训练可匹配全参数 RL 训练效果。
items.value: RL 后训练可能只需微调单层，大幅降低计算成本。

items.title: Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization：面向 Agent 强化学习的高效异步优化框架。
items.value: 解决长周期 Agent 任务中同步 RL 的低效问题，提升训练稳定性。

items.title: Institutional Red-Teaming：提出多 Agent 部署规则测试方法论，固定 Agent 仅变规则。
items.value: 系统性评估多 Agent 安全，提供可复现的测试框架。

items.title: How Data Shapes RoPE Frequency Usage：数据决定 RoPE 频率使用，提出位置尺度匹配理论。
items.value: 解释 RoPE 外推失败根源，为长度泛化提供理论指导。

items.title: SWE-Review：用 Agent 代码审查闭环解决 Issue，AI 生成 PR 后自动审查与修订。
items.value: 从“一次生成”到“审查修订”闭环，提升 AI 编码可靠性。

items.title: AgentLens：基于生产评估的编码 Agent 轨迹评测基准。
items.value: 评估整个执行轨迹而非单一通过/失败，更贴近真实使用体验。

items.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.desc: 面向 AI 编码 Agent 的生产级工程技能集。
items.value: 即插即用的工程技能库，提升 Agent 在真实项目中的表现。

items.title: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
items.desc: 基于 Claude Code 的 AI 求职框架，自动评估岗位、定制简历。
items.value: 展示 Agent 在复杂工作流中的实际应用潜力。

items.title: iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI
items.desc: 专为 AI Agent 构建的 Office 套件命令行工具，无需安装 Office。
items.value: Agent 可直接读写编辑 Word/Excel/PPT，单二进制文件，开源免费。

items.title: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks
items.desc: 收集各大 AI 模型系统提示词，持续更新。
items.value: 了解竞品提示工程策略，优化自身 Agent 设计。

items.title: openai/codex-plugin-cc
items.desc: 让 Claude Code 调用 OpenAI Codex 进行代码审查或任务委派。
items.value: 跨模型协作新范式，Agent 可自主选择最优模型完成任务。

items.title: microsoft/flint-chart
items.desc: AI Agent 可可靠创建美观图表的可视化语言。
items.value: 解决 Agent 生成可视化图表不可靠的痛点，简单人类可编辑规范。

items.title: TencentCloud/CubeSandbox
items.desc: 腾讯云开源的即时、并发、安全、轻量级 AI Agent 沙箱。
items.value: 为 Agent 提供安全的代码执行环境，适合企业部署。

items.title: stablyai/orca
items.desc: 并行 Agent 工作台，支持用自己的订阅运行任意编码 Agent。
items.value: 桌面和移动端均可使用，管理多个 Agent 并行工作。

items.title: calesthio/OpenMontage
items.desc: 全球首个开源 Agent 视频制作系统，12 条流水线、52 个工具。
items.value: 将 AI 编码助手转变为完整视频制作工作室。

items.title: VoltAgent/awesome-design-md
items.desc: 知名品牌设计系统 DESIGN.md 文件集合，Agent 可生成匹配 UI。
items.value: Agent 驱动的 UI 设计标准化，提升前端开发效率。

items.title: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
items.desc: 将任意 AI Agent 转变为 AI 科学家的技能库，16 万科学家使用。
items.value: 140 个即用技能 + 100+ 科学数据库，覆盖生物、化学、医学、药物发现。

items.title: kyutai-labs/pocket-tts
items.desc: 可在 CPU 上运行的轻量级 TTS 模型。
items.value: 无需 GPU，边缘设备也能高质量语音合成。

items.title: Anthropic 建议将昂贵的 Claude Fable 5 作为“管理者”委派任务给 Sonnet 5，以 63% 成本达到 92% 性能。
items.desc: 这一“Advisor”模式引发开发者广泛讨论：推理模型是否应主要作为规划器而非执行器使用。

items.title: Kenton Varda（Cloudflare Workers 创始人）宣布团队禁止 AI 编写变更描述（PR/commit 消息），称其“比无用更糟”——只描述代码细节而忽略高层上下文。
items.desc: 这一观点在 Hacker News 和技术 Twitter 上引发关于 AI 辅助编程最佳实践的激烈辩论。

en.headline: OpenAI officially launches GPT-5.6 family (Luna/Terra/Sol) with government approval, and introduces "ChatGPT Work" autonomous agent.
en.observation: Today is undeniably a "model launch explosion" day: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 + ChatGPT Work, SpaceX's Grok 4.5, and Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 all launched simultaneously, marking a shift from "who's strongest" to "who's cheapest and most practical." GPT-5.6 Sol achieves near-Fable 5 performance at one-third the cost, while Grok 4.5 and Muse Spark 1.1 push pricing to new lows—the price war is white-hot. Meanwhile, multiple open-source projects (OfficeCLI, flint-chart, CubeSandbox) show the community building infrastructure for agents rather than just chasing models. Notably, OpenAI's discovery that ~30% of SWE-Bench Pro tasks are broken reminds us that industry evaluation systems still need improvement.

items.title: OpenAI officially launches GPT-5.6 family (Luna/Terra/Sol) with government approval, and introduces "ChatGPT Work" autonomous agent.
items.value: Three-tier pricing; Sol beats all competitors in agentic coding; ChatGPT Work automates cross-app workflows.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-Live full-duplex voice model, ChatGPT can listen and speak simultaneously for more human-like conversation.
items.value: Full-duplex architecture transforms voice interaction; complex tasks auto-delegated to GPT-5.5.

items.title: SpaceX releases Grok 4.5 at half the price of competitors, focused on coding and autonomous agents.
items.value: 1.5T params, $2/M input tokens; price-performance dominance could reshape API pricing.

items.title: Meta launches Muse Spark 1.1 with API, priced even lower than Grok 4.5.
items.value: $4.25/M output tokens, supports large-scale agent workloads and code migrations, intensifying price war.

items.title: OpenAI shuts down ChatGPT Atlas browser, integrates agentic browsing into desktop app and Chrome extension.
items.value: Strategic pivot to ChatGPT Work product line instead of standalone browser.

items.title: Anthropic to charge usage-based fees for Claude Fable 5, signaling end of cheap AI subscription era.
items.value: Fable 5's high reasoning cost makes usage-based pricing the new normal.

items.title: OpenAI's Chief Future Scientist departs; Anthropic launches Claude usage recap "Reflect"; Mistral releases 8B robot navigation model.
items.value: Talent churn and product acceleration; open-source robot models lower entry barriers.

items.title: Databricks makes Chinese open-source model GLM 5.2 its default coding engine after matching Opus at lower cost.
items.value: $1.28/task vs $1.94; open-source models can now replace closed-source flagships in specific scenarios.

items.title: OpenAI finds ~30% of tasks in popular SWE-Bench Pro benchmark are broken, retracts prior endorsement.
items.value: Industry benchmark reliability questioned; developers should build custom evaluation systems.

items.title: New York Times accuses OpenAI of hiding evidence in copyright case, faking inability to search training data.
items.value: Escalating legal battle could impact AI training data compliance practices.

items.title: Google will now disclose which ads are made with AI, requiring advertisers to label AI-generated/edited content.
items.value: New AI ad transparency rules impact digital marketing compliance standards.

items.title: 69% of enterprises have shared API key security risks with AI agents; a single compromised agent can affect all.
items.value: Agent security practices need urgent standardization; credential management is critical.

items.title: OpenAI explores multiple ad formats, building advertising business.
items.value: OpenAI accelerates monetization; ads could become a major revenue stream.

items.title: Agon: Competitive cross-model RL framework where two models grade each other to improve reasoning quality.
items.value: Addresses GRPO's limitation of scoring only final answers; trains models to "think better."

items.title: LingBot-Video: World's first MoE video foundation model for embodied intelligence, open-sourced by Ant LingBot.
items.value: MoE architecture designed for robotics; 150K hours of training data; 31% zero-shot improvement.

items.title: LingBot-World 2.0: World model achieves "hour-level" sustained generation for the first time, supporting 60fps 720p real-time output.
items.value: Causal pretraining enables unbounded interaction; real-time variant drives video streams; native multi-person AI interaction.

items.title: Sparse Delta Memory: Scales linear RNN state to millions via sparsity, matching Transformer in long-context recall.
items.value: Breaks linear attention's long-context bottleneck while maintaining computational efficiency.

items.title: Is One Layer Enough? Single transformer layer training can match full-parameter RL training.
items.value: RL post-training may only need single-layer fine-tuning, dramatically reducing compute costs.

items.title: Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization: Efficient async optimization framework for agentic RL.
items.value: Addresses synchronous RL inefficiency in long-horizon agent tasks; improves training stability.

items.title: Institutional Red-Teaming: Methodology for testing multi-agent deployment rules, holding agents fixed and varying only rules.
items.value: Systematic multi-agent safety evaluation with reproducible testing framework.

items.title: How Data Shapes RoPE Frequency Usage: Data determines RoPE frequency usage, proposes positional scale matching theory.
items.value: Explains root cause of RoPE extrapolation failures; provides theoretical guidance for length generalization.

items.title: SWE-Review: Closing the loop on issue resolution with agentic code review; auto-review and revision of AI-generated PRs.
items.value: From "one-shot generation" to "review-revise" loop; improves AI coding reliability.

items.title: AgentLens: Production-assessed trajectory review benchmark for coding agents.
items.value: Evaluates entire execution trajectory rather than single pass/fail; closer to real-world usage.

items.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.desc: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
items.value: Plug-and-play engineering skill library; improves agent performance in real projects.

items.title: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
items.desc: AI-powered job application framework built on Claude Code; auto-evaluates jobs, tailors CVs.
items.value: Demonstrates agent potential in complex real-world workflows.

items.title: iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI
items.desc: Office suite CLI purpose-built for AI agents; no Office installation required.
items.value: Agents can directly read/write/edit Word/Excel/PPT; single binary, open-source, free.

items.title: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks
items.desc: Collection of system prompts from major AI models, regularly updated.
items.value: Understand competitor prompt engineering strategies; optimize your own agent design.

items.title: openai/codex-plugin-cc
items.desc: Lets Claude Code call OpenAI Codex for code review or task delegation.
items.value: New cross-model collaboration paradigm; agents can autonomously choose the best model.

items.title: microsoft/flint-chart
items.desc: Visualization language for AI agents to reliably create beautiful charts.
items.value: Solves unreliable agent chart generation; simple human-editable specs.

items.title: TencentCloud/CubeSandbox
items.desc: Instant, concurrent, secure, lightweight sandbox for AI agents.
items.value: Secure code execution environment for agents; suitable for enterprise deployment.

items.title: stablyai/orca
items.desc: Parallel agent workbench; run any coding agent with your own subscription.
items.value: Desktop and mobile support; manage multiple agents working in parallel.

items.title: calesthio/OpenMontage
items.desc: World's first open-source agentic video production system; 12 pipelines, 52 tools.
items.value: Turns AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.

items.title: VoltAgent/awesome-design-md
items.desc: Collection of DESIGN.md files from famous brand design systems; agents can generate matching UI.
items.value: Standardized agent-driven UI design; improves frontend development efficiency.

items.title: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
items.desc: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist; 160K+ scientists using it.
items.value: 140 ready-to-use skills + 100+ scientific databases; covers biology, chemistry, medicine, drug discovery.

items.title: kyutai-labs/pocket-tts
items.desc: Lightweight TTS model that runs on CPU.
items.value: No GPU needed; high-quality speech synthesis on edge devices.

items.title: Anthropic recommends using expensive Claude Fable 5 as a "manager" that delegates to Sonnet 5, achieving 92% performance at 63% cost.
items.desc: This "Advisor" pattern sparks widespread developer discussion: should reasoning models serve primarily as planners rather than executors?

items.title: Kenton Varda (Cloudflare Workers founder) announces team ban on AI-written change descriptions (PR/commit messages), calling them "worse than useless"—detailing code-level specifics while omitting high-level context.
items.desc: This view ignites heated debate on Hacker News and tech Twitter about AI-assisted programming best practices.
